items.title: VisionQuest
items.overview: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

items.title: Below
items.overview: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

items.title: East of Eden
items.overview: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

items.title: LEGO ONE PIECE
items.overview: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

items.title: The Final Problem
items.overview: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

items.title: My Sad Dead
items.overview: A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.

items.title: The Doll
items.overview: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

items.title: Minimum Security
items.overview: Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie.

items.title: City of Blood
items.overview: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

items.title: Cathedrals
items.overview: A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.

items.title: Tommy & Tuppence
items.overview: A detective duo for the ages, Tommy and Tuppence fall in love, fall out of it, and tumble back in, all while solving some thrilling and entertaining mysteries along the way.

items.title: A Killer Story
items.overview: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

items.title: Marble Hall Murders
items.overview: Returning to England, Susan Ryeland is reluctantly drawn into a new Atticus Pünd mystery, this time written by a new, young writer. 'Pünd’s Last Case" is a story set in 1955, in an exotic villa in Corfu – but the identity of a real killer is hidden in the text, and once again Susan is going to find herself in grave danger.

items.title: A Tale of Two Cities
items.overview: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

items.listTitle: All the Truth in My Lies
items.title: All the Truth in My Lies
items.overview: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.

items.title: Summertime
items.overview: After 19 years of friendship, Eun-ho is oblivious to Do-hyun’s obsessive crush. But a new student’s arrival threatens to expose the perfect façade.

items.title: Lion
items.overview: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

items.title: Hold on, Harutora-kun
items.overview: To survive his boys' dorm, guarded Sui hides behind indifference. But a warm, honest new roommate threatens to break down the walls around his heart.

items.listTitle: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
items.title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
items.overview: Tracing Charles Manson's rise as a cult leader, the 1969 murders, and his trial, using unreleased prison recordings, interviews, and archival footage.

items.title: Possession
items.overview: Claudia, a bi-racial lawyer, journeys to Jamaica's haunted Connaught plantation to fight an inheritance claim. Uncovering dark historical secrets intertwined with modern injustices intensifies her nightmare.

items.listTitle: After Moving Seats, The Boy Behind Me Has A Crush On Me
items.title: After Moving Seats, The Boy Behind Me Has A Crush On Me
items.overview: A simple seating change sparks an unlikely romance when the most popular boy in school confesses to his quiet classmate.

items.listTitle: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
items.title: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
items.overview: A successful entrepreneur with a seemingly perfect life sees everything fall apart after discovering her husband covering up a murder allegedly committed by their daughter. As the family scrambles to hide the truth, an anonymous blackmailer claims to have recorded everything, pulling them into a dangerous web of lies, secrets, and betrayal.

items.title: Duty First, Kiss Later
items.overview: An old-school detective and his cold, ambitious partner find their growing attraction complicating life inside a rural police station.

items.title: Summer of 1985
items.overview: In the summer of 1985, a young boy is found mysteriously drowned in the waters off Särsö. During a forbidden excursion to the legendary island of Svärtan, Johannes and his friends make a discovery that changes them forever.

items.listTitle: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
items.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
items.overview: A historical exploration about the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D. and the preserved Roman city it left behind.

items.title: The Map of Longing
items.overview: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

items.title: Ride or Die
items.overview: Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.

items.title: Worst Neighbor Ever
items.overview: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

items.title: Knot
items.overview: A young man’s life changes forever when a powerful Alpha marks him, binding their fates together in an inescapable bond.

items.title: Don't Be Too Emotional
items.overview: A football player befriends a mysterious wish-granter whose dangerous gifts hide secrets that draw them closer together.

items.title: The American Experiment
items.overview: Life. Liberty. The pursuit of happiness. This sweeping historical documentary series traces how the ideals of America's founders gave rise to a nation.

items.title: See You at Work Tomorrow!
items.overview: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

items.title: Ultras: Passion and Death
items.overview: Ultras: Passion and Death is an HBO docuseries that explores the violent and deeply rooted Spanish "ultras" football fan movement by examining three specific tragedies that forever altered the nation's sporting and cultural landscape. The series uncovers how the passion of fandom can escalate into extreme aggression and tribalism.

items.title: I Will Find You
items.overview: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

items.title: The Vampire Lestat
items.overview: The Vampire Lestat goes on tour while being haunted by "muses" from his past. As the band's popularity grows, so does Lestat's influence over vampires & humans alike, leaving others to contend with Lestat's power in the face of the Great Conversion.

items.title: The Witness
items.overview: With their 2-year-old as the sole witness to her murder, Rachel Nickell's partner fights to protect him amid a flawed investigation.

items.title: Michael Jackson: The Verdict
items.overview: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.

items.title: Tip Toe
items.overview: An ordinary Manchester suburb becomes a minefield of lies and violence when Leo gives neighbour Clive his spare key.

items.title: Brazil '70: The Third Star
items.overview: In 1970, the Brazilian national team took the field with big dreams and an even bigger challenge: to become the first three-time world champions.

items.title: Abandoned
items.overview: In 1984, three children were abandoned at a Barcelona train station with no memory of their identity or past. Unclaimed, they were adopted into loving homes. As adults, they now search for their biological parents.

items.title: My 2 Cents
items.overview: When his friend Wild Boar lands himself in hot water with organized crime, Zero and the gang unite to save him while barely coping with their own lives.

items.title: Dear England
items.overview: Haunted by decades of failures, Gareth Southgate becomes England manager and uses psychology to confront fear and pursue victory.

items.title: Two Weeks in August
items.overview: A Greek holiday with friends to relax and reconnect. But when Zoe acts on her desires, heaven quickly turns into hell. Witty, painfully relatable drama starring Jessica Raine.

items.title: Ravalear: Not for Sale
items.overview: In Barcelona’s Raval neighbourhood, the family-run restaurant “Can Mosques” faces eviction after an investment fund buys the building. The family’s fight to survive escalates, pushing them to cross any and all boundaries.

items.title: James.
items.overview: James Rodríguez, Colombia's legendary No. 10, shares details of his journey to football's elite and the game's biggest stage.

items.listTitle: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.title: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.overview: Hungry for a new heist, Berlin summons the gang to Seville and turns an ambitious duke into the victim of his own plan: to steal a da Vinci masterpiece.

items.title: Soul Mate
items.overview: In a moment of despair, Ryu Narutaki finds himself saved by Korean boxer Johan Hwang. As their wounded souls draw closer, their fates cruelly intertwine.

items.title: My Royal Nemesis
items.overview: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

items.title: Lisbon Noir
items.overview: A Spanish diplomat falls from the top of the Aqueduct. The police investigate with the help of a Spanish inspector. It quickly becomes clear that there is a serial killer in Lisbon, inspired by the legendary "Aqueduct Killer" of the 19th century: Diego Alves. When the police seem close to solving the case, a twist reveals that the psychopath is still at large, this time driven by personal revenge.

items.title: The Grand-ish Tour
items.overview: Gathering in the care home where they now live, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May host three special shows looking back at their favourite Grand Tour moments. Or at least the ones they can remember. Their fading memories stretch from California to Mongolia to Italy and everywhere in between, and include classic moments of misery featuring mud, water, and at least two actual injuries.

items.title: The House of the Spirits
items.overview: The epic tale of a proud and passionate family, secret loves, and bloody revolution. The Trueba family's passions, struggles, and secrets span a century of violent social change, culminating in a crisis that hurls the proud, tyrannical patriarch and his beloved granddaughter towards opposite sides of the fence.

items.title: Half Man
items.overview: When Niall's estranged 'brother' Ruben shows up at his wedding, it leads to an explosion of violence that catapults us back through their lives.

items.title: Fake Fact Lips
items.overview: Lifelong rivals Ryo and Zen take their office war to a new level — the first one to make the other fall in love wins the ultimate bet.

items.title: Hulk Hogan: Real American
items.overview: Before he was Hulk Hogan, he was Terry Bollea. Uncover the man behind the legend in this unfiltered documentary featuring his very last interview.

items.title: Ronaldinho: The One and Only
items.overview: This series follows the life and career of Brazilian soccer star Ronaldinho, tracing his journey from young prodigy to global sports icon.

items.title: Someone Has to Know
items.overview: A boy vanishes, and no one can find him. An open-and-shut case, except there are no leads. Three hundred people around him, and no one saw anything?

items.title: Perfect Crown
items.overview: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

items.listTitle: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
items.title: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
items.overview: After shielding himself and his daughter from his family for over a decade, Malcolm is dragged back into their orbit when Hal and Lois demand his presence at their 40th anniversary party.

items.title: Trust Me: The False Prophet
items.overview: In this true-crime documentary, a cult expert and filmmaker infiltrate a polygamist sect to expose a self-proclaimed prophet and bring him to justice.

items.title: Feel What You Feel
items.overview: Two very different male college students – one bold and confident, one quiet and introverted – secretly develop feelings for each other.

items.title: Secrets of the Bees
items.overview: With the expertise of entomologist and fellow National Geographic Explorer Dr. Samuel Ramsey, the series uses groundbreaking filming technology to reveal the extraordinary world of bees; and uncover their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets and featuring never-before-filmed moments.

items.title: The Predator of Seville
items.overview: For years, Manuel Blanco was known among international students as “Manu White”, a friendly guide who organised cheap trips across Spain. But behind that image lay a far darker story. The case came to light when several young women began to connect experiences of abuse that had previously seemed unrelated.

items.listTitle: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
items.title: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
items.overview: A bride has a feeling that something horrifying will happen at her wedding — and the closer to the altar she gets, the worse it becomes.

items.title: For one hundred million
items.overview: In 1981, three mechanics from Zaragoza, Alfonso, Jorge, and Salva, overwhelmed by debts and after months without work, decided to kidnap the top scorer of the League, Enrique Castro 'Quini', the forward of FC Barcelona. In exchange for his release, they ask for 100 million pesetas. But soon they discover, the hard way, that life is not like in the movies. And that being bad, when you are good, is not easy at all.

items.title: The Prosecutor
items.overview: This raw docuseries is about the head of the new Femicide Investigation Unit in Mexico City, a department established to stop violence against women.

items.title: The Faithful
items.overview: This event series is told through the eyes of the courageous and passionate, yet flawed women whose descendants would shape three of the world's great faiths: Judaism, Christianity and Islam.

items.title: ONE PIECE BONUS CONTENT
items.overview: Take a voyage behind the scenes in this showcase of the effects, Easter eggs and jaw-dropping stunts that brought Season 2 to life.

items.title: Dynasty: The Murdochs
items.overview: Offers an unprecedented look at one the world’s most powerful families at a crossroads, as its patriarch, Rupert Murdoch, makes one last play to ensure his legacy at all costs.

items.title: The Dinosaurs
items.overview: From the first dinosaurs to the last, this epic documentary series examines their 165 million years on Earth and the forces that shaped their evolution.

items.title: The TikTok Killer
items.overview: When Esther vanishes without a trace, her family is able to piece together her last movements thanks to José Jurado Montilla, a traveler who journeys across Spain sharing heartfelt videos of his trips on his TikTok account. But “Dynamite” Montilla – the last person to have been with Esther – hides a dark past

items.title: Always Meet Again
items.overview: After waking up as his 18-year-old self, a famous painter reunites with his first love and faces a rare chance to rewrite their story.

items.title: A Friend, a Murderer
items.overview: A Danish town feared a serial criminal for eight years. When caught, Amanda, Nichlas and Kiri discovered the perpetrator was their close friend who'd committed assaults, kidnappings and murder while spending time with them.

items.title: The Hunt
items.overview: When friends on a hunting trip get into a deadly clash with other hunters, they vow to keep it a secret. But as paranoia sets in—and a ruthless gang seeks revenge—the friends must confront their morality, families, and savage instincts.

items.title: DTF St. Louis
items.overview: A love triangle among three adults experiencing middle-age malaise leads to one of them ending up dead.

items.title: Seeking Persephone
items.overview: To save her family, Persephone marries a cold, distant duke - never expecting to awaken a love that could change them both forever.

items.title: Dirty Business
items.overview: Two amateur detectives in an Oxfordshire village discover dying fish in their river. When they contact the water company for answers, the company's odd, evasive response prompts them to launch an investigation that continues today.

items.title: The Lady
items.overview: Jane Andrews' life changes overnight when she lands a dream job in Buckingham Palace and bonds with the Duchess of York.

items.listTitle: Reality Check: Inside America's Next Top Model
items.title: Reality Check: Inside America's Next Top Model
items.overview: What started as a glamorous launchpad for aspiring models became a pop-culture juggernaut defined by explosive drama, public meltdowns, and controversies that still fuel viral moments today.

items.title: Lead Children
items.overview: When a young doctor discovers that children living near a smelting plant suffer from lead poisoning, she risks her career and safety to save them.

items.listTitle: The Scream Murder: A True Teen Horror Story
items.title: The Scream Murder: A True Teen Horror Story
items.overview: When high school student Cassie Stoddart is found stabbed to death in a house on the outskirts of Pocatello, Idaho, the community is gripped by fear that a random killer is on the loose. Police retrace Cassie's final hours and focus on three classmates that were the last people to see her alive. As the investigation narrows, detectives uncover a shocking buried video tape that reframes the case, raising the unthinkable question of whether 16-year-olds could have committed such a brutal crime.

items.title: Motorvalley
items.overview: Desperate to gain control of her family's racing empire, an heiress hires a reckless driver and a troubled coach to compete in the Italian Gran Turismo.

items.title: Lord of the Flies
items.overview: After a plane crash, a group of schoolboys find themselves stranded on a tropical island without adults. Ralph is elected leader and, with the help of the intelligent Piggy, strives to maintain order and civilization. Jack, responsible for the signal fire, becomes increasingly focused on hunting and power struggles. This leads to tensions within the group, gradually pushing the boys from hope and structure into chaos and tragedy.

items.title: The Borderline
items.overview: A border town cop uncovers an illegal drug trade tied to his childhood friend and a ruthless British crime syndicate operating in the scenic 1000 Islands region between Canada and the U.S.

items.title: Love After Addiction
items.overview: A shamed actor uses his insomnia as a trap to lure a former classmate closer, but his calculated game turns into a real, messy addiction.

items.title: Vanished
items.overview: When a romantic getaway to Paris takes a dark turn with the sudden disappearance of her boyfriend Tom aboard a train to the south of France, Alice is plunged into a web of intrigue and danger, uncovering shocking secrets about the man she thought she knew.

items.listTitle: The Boy Next World: My Destiny
items.title: The Boy Next World: My Destiny
items.overview: A college student’s ordinary life turns upside down when a mysterious senior claims they’re lovers from a parallel world.

items.title: Glitter & Gold: Ice Dancing
items.overview: Delves into competitive ice dance's intense world, where deep partnerships, total dedication, and raw emotions merge in the pursuit of Olympic gold.

items.title: Take That
items.overview: The story of one of the greatest boy bands in UK history. For more than 30 years, they have brought us hit after hit, 12 of which became UK number ones.

items.title: Blind Sherlock
items.overview: Blessed with exceptional hearing, blind Roman Mertens lands his dream job in the local police wiretapping unit — a job more dangerous than he expected.

items.listTitle: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!
items.title: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!
items.overview: Directors Judd Apatow and Michael Bonfiglio explore the life and legacy of Mel Brooks, one of the most enduring comedic voices of our time.

items.title: Handsome Devil: Charming Killer
items.overview: A three-part docuseries that unravels how Wade Wilson — a 25-year-old Florida man arrested for the brutal murders of two women — unexpectedly became a social media fixation.

items.title: Can This Love Be Translated?
items.overview: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

items.title: Candy
items.overview: Nuannuan—the girl she once left behind in her youth—reenters her life as an assistant. Under the pressure of fame and public scrutiny, the two escape the city to join a rural reality show. Meanwhile, veteran manager Si Han and superstar Jiang Wan are locked in a fierce game of love and power, entangled in workplace rivalry and unresolved past feelings. Between tenderness and cruelty, sincerity and calculation, two GL love stories unfold against the unforgiving reality of the entertainment industry.

items.title: Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
items.overview: England, 1925. At a lavish country house party, a practical joke appears to have gone horribly, murderously wrong. It will be up to the unlikeliest of sleuths—the fizzingly inquisitive Lady Eileen 'Bundle' Brent—to unravel a chilling plot that will change her life, cracking wide open the country house mystery.

items.title: Countdown to Yes
items.overview: Reunited with his first love after three years, Wataru must choose between protecting a lifelong friendship and risking it all for romance.

items.title: Paparazzi King
items.overview: Explore the life and career of paparazzi king Fabrizio Corona, reflecting Italy's recent history of scandals and social change.

items.title: Pelayo: Más Allá Del Límite
items.overview: An immersive, three-episode docuseries narrated in the first person by Pelayo Gayol, revealing the darkest side of drug trafficking, not as a distant phenomenon, but as a global system that transforms violence into a business. It's a journey of no return to the heart of a silent war where looking the other way is no longer an option. Gayol leaves his role as an instructor to try to understand the roots of the conflict from the frontlines.

items.title: HIS & HERS
items.overview: Two estranged spouses — one a detective, the other a news reporter — vie to solve a murder in which each believes the other is a prime suspect.

items.listTitle: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
items.title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
items.overview: Follows the Andrea Yates case, exploring how a rogue street preacher's fire-and-brimstone teachings allegedly brought the vulnerable Texas mother under his control, leading to the drowning of her five children in 2001.

items.title: Spring Fever
items.overview: After moving to a quiet rural town to heal from past heartbreak, a withdrawn teacher slowly rediscovers warmth and joy through her unexpected connection with a rough-around-the-edges but kindhearted local man.

items.title: Run Away
items.overview: A desperate father searching for his runaway daughter gets caught up in a murder case — and stumbles upon secrets which could destroy his family for good.

items.title: Time Flies
items.overview: Fresh out of prison and low on options, two women run a fumigation business — until a shady client pulls them back into the life they fought to escape.

items.title: Titanic Sinks Tonight
items.overview: Minute by minute - the night the unsinkable ship sank. Vivid first-hand accounts from passengers and crew tell the story of the most infamous disaster in maritime history.

items.title: Heaven
items.overview: ​After an encounter with a faith healer, a young man finds refuge at a commune where disciples are forced to give up everything for God.

items.title: Amadeus
items.overview: 25-year-old Amadeus arrives in Vienna, unemployed after his father’s death. He allies with singer Constanze Weber, who helps bring him into the orbit of court composer Salieri, igniting a rivalry that defines their legacies.

items.title: Love Me
items.overview: An OB-GYN who seems to have it all hides the pain of running away from her family after a tragic accident, until a man who sees through her loneliness enters her life and changes everything.

items.title: Rififi
items.overview: "RIFIFI" is inspired by the notorious bank robbery that took place in Athens in 1992. Who carried it out and why? The authorities spoke of organized crime, terrorist groups, and highly educated, ruthless perpetrators. But was it really like that? Through the power of fiction, the new production by COSMOTE TV combines the biggest heist ever committed in Greece with a true story of human tragedy, creating a character-driven series full of emotion and strong elements of humor.

items.title: City of Shadows
items.overview: A gruesome crime has taken place in La Pedrera – Casa Milà: a burned body is found on the facade of Gaudí's iconic building. Inspector Milo Malart, previously suspended for misconduct by the Mossos d'Esquadra (Mossos of the Squadron), returns to Barcelona to find the perpetrator along with Sub-Inspector Rebeca Garrido.

items.title: The Revenge Club
items.overview: Six strangers are brought together by a divorce support group who quickly transform from therapy-seeking victims into architects of retribution. With little in common beyond their pain, they form an unlikely bond. What begins as a cathartic outlet quickly spirals into something far more dangerous.

items.title: The End of an Era
items.overview: A behind-the-scenes docuseries event chronicling the development, impact, and inner workings that created the phenomenon that was Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour, as well as providing an intimate look at Taylor's life as her tour made headlines and thrilled fans around the world. The series also spotlights performers, family members, and friends — including Gracie Abrams, Sabrina Carpenter, Ed Sheeran, and Florence Welch — offering never-before-seen insight into what it took to create a phenomenon.

items.title: Man vs Baby
items.overview: As Christmas approaches, a blundering-all-the-way dad juggles housesitting a posh London penthouse with an unexpected pickle: caring for a lost baby.

items.listTitle: The War Between the Land and the Sea
items.title: The War Between the Land and the Sea
items.overview: When a fearsome and ancient species emerges from the ocean, dramatically revealing themselves to humanity, an international crisis is triggered. With the entire population at risk, UNIT step into action as the land and sea wage war.

items.title: Spartacus: House of Ashur
items.overview: In a world where he survived the events of Spartacus, Ashur clawed his way to power, owning the same ludus that once owned him. Allying with a fierce gladiatrix, Ashur ignites a new kind of spectacle that offends the elite.

items.title: Sicily Express
items.overview: With Christmas around the corner, two blundering Sicilian friends working in Milan discover a dumpster that transports them to their families in seconds.

items.title: Sean Combs: The Reckoning
items.overview: A revealing look at Sean 'Diddy' Combs' journey from music mogul to high-profile sexual offender, featuring footage and insider accounts that expose both his groundbreaking success with Bad Boy Entertainment and the troubling shadows behind his empire.

items.title: Silence
items.overview: In the shadows of history, a secret beats like a pulse. Two vampire sisters survive a shortage of “clean human blood” during the Black Death, but the true poison is the silence that surrounds them. Centuries later, one of their descendants faces the same conflict during the AIDS pandemic in Spain and discovers that social condemnation has not changed. Love between the “sick” and the “healthy,” between humans and vampires, still inspires the same terror. What happens when eternity is measured in centuries of silence?

items.title: Thundercloud Rainstorm
items.overview: Bound by a debt, an illegitimate son moves in with his aloof cousin, unaware that their uneasy deal will spiral into a deep and dangerous obsession.

items.title: Prisoner 951
items.overview: The true story of Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe - imprisoned in Iran and separated from her daughter - and her husband Richard, who fights both the British and Iranian governments to facilitate her release.

items.listTitle: Love Begins in the World of If
items.title: Love Begins in the World of If
items.overview: After wishing to change his life, a quiet worker awakens in a parallel world where he’s confident—and loved by the colleague he admires.

items.title: The Anatomy of a Moment
items.overview: Madrid, Spain, February 23, 1981. A group of Civil Guards storm into the Congress of Deputies and terrorize those present by firing shots into the air. Only three men remain unmoved: Prime Minister Adolfo Suárez; Vice President Manuel Gutiérrez Mellado; and Santiago Carrillo, leader of the Communist Party.

items.title: Menace imminente
items.overview: A legend of Israeli intelligence, Zeev Abadi, is urgently called back to track down the traitor who stole extremely dangerous software developed in the utmost secrecy by Unit 8200, a branch of the Israeli Army, and used for the first time in Paris. This mission leads him to collaborate with a French anti-terrorism cop, Fleur Giroud, who is tasked with solving a strange disappearance that occurred in broad daylight at Charles de Gaulle Airport...

items.title: To My Shore
items.overview: After a car accident, a ruthless Thai heir and a reserved company executive become trapped in a dangerous game of desire that spirals into obsession.

items.title: The Crystal Cuckoo
items.overview: Hoping to learn more about her heart donor, a young doctor arrives in a mountain town where decades of mysterious tragedies plague the small community.

items.title: Fortress
items.overview: Everyone has to grow up, to separate from their parents, to start their own family. Luka and Daria try to do this while everything around them is falling apart: friendships, families, even the country.

items.title: LEGO Marvel Avengers: Strange Tails
items.overview: Hawkeye and The Avengers have made saving the world look easy. But now they face their wildest threat yet: SOCIAL MEDIA. To save the world, a new team must be recruited to help our heroes contend with an influencer bent on cataclysmic destruction.

items.title: Ângela Diniz: Murdered and Convicted
items.overview: Based on true events, it follows socialite Ângela Diniz as her murder becomes a national flashpoint, turning the ensuing trial into a defining moment in the country’s history

items.title: Tiffany Haddish Goes Off
items.overview: Comedian and actress Tiffany Haddish journeys to Africa on a four-week-long girls trip with her three closest childhood friends Selena Martin, Shermona Long, and Sparkle Clark. Throughout the trip they take on new adventures, deepen their lifelong friendship, and explore personal connections to the continent.

items.listTitle: 50 Seconds: The Fernando Báez Sosa Case
items.title: 50 Seconds: The Fernando Báez Sosa Case
items.overview: This documentary series explores the case of Fernando Báez Sosa, whose fatal beating by a group of young men was caught on video, shocking Argentina.

items.title: Mrs Playmen
items.overview: Betrayed by her husband, a woman must step up and run an erotic magazine that becomes a symbol of empowerment in '70s Rome. Inspired by true events.

items.title: Kingdom
items.overview: Filmed across five years in a single spectacular location, the lives and fates of our four families - leopards, hyenas, wild dogs, and lions - are inextricably linked as they strive for a foothold in a remote and fertile river valley in Zambia.

items.title: All Her Fault
items.overview: In Chicago, Marissa Irvine arrives at 14 Arthur Avenue, expecting to pick up her young son Milo from his first playdate with a boy at his new school. But the woman who answers the door isn't a mother she recognizes. She isn't the nanny. She doesn't have Milo. And so begins every parent's worst nightmare.

items.title: The Vallecas Files
items.overview: Three decades after the mysterious death of a 17-year-old girl, her family relives the traumatic events in Spain's highest-profile paranormal case.

items.title: Empire with David Olusoga
items.overview: How did a small island once rule over a quarter of the world's population? This shared history still shapes us today - and billions of people are part of its story.

items.title: Death by Lightning
items.overview: The story of James Garfield, who rose from obscurity to become America's 20th President — and Charles Guiteau, the man who assassinated him.

items.title: War of the Kingdoms
items.overview: Burgundy is surrounded by enemies. Siegfried's arrival sparks new hope, but King Gunther is hatching a dangerous plan. Much to the displeasure of master-at-arms Hagen, who is secretly in love with the king's daughter Kriemhild.

items.title: Heweliusz
items.overview: After a catastrophic ferry disaster, the off-duty captain seeks answers and justice for those who lost their lives — and those they left behind.

items.listTitle: Start Up, Fall Down: From Billionaire to Convict
items.title: Start Up, Fall Down: From Billionaire to Convict
items.overview: One of Milan's most exclusive parties takes a dark turn when a woman reports sexual assault. This documentary chronicles the investigation that followed.

items.title: Those Who Lived
items.overview: Marie, Caroline, Sébastien, Arnaud, Grégory, Stéphane and David were all hostages during the November 13, 2015 terrorist attack in the Bataclan in Paris. From their miraculous survival was born a unique and unbreakable bond.

items.title: Nice to Not Meet You
items.overview: A hateful romance between a professional detective actor who wants to become a melodrama master and a female reporter who was demoted from a political reporter who won the Reporter of the Year award to the entertainment department.

items.title: Fortnite x The Simpsons
items.overview: Springfield and Fortnite universes converge. Chaos ensues as Homer sets out to transform the world, wielding a powerful alien energy.

items.title: Bad Influencer
items.overview: A single mother — and luxury bag counterfeiter — finds herself teaming up with a self-obsessed influencer to sell her bags and scrape her way out of debt.

items.title: Therapy Game
items.overview: After a one-night stand, a photographer bets he can win over the heartbroken vet student, only to get entangled in the chaotic mess of his own game.

items.title: My Safe Zone
items.overview: Alin leaves her best friend Jane to study abroad. Years later, a broken engagement brings her home, where they face feelings long unspoken.

items.title: Harlan Coben's Lazarus
items.overview: Forensic psychiatrist Dr Joel 'Laz' Lazarus is forced to confront long-buried demons after his father Dr L dies in suspicious circumstances. At first assured his dad's death is a suicide, Laz is soon sucked into a world of murderous conspiracy, and a race to find the killer, by strange visions of people he knows to be dead.

items.title: The Monster of Florence
items.overview: As a serial killer targets couples and strikes terror in Italy, authorities explore a case from 1968 that may be key to finding The Monster of Florence.

items.listTitle: School Trip: Joined a Group I'm Not Close To
items.title: School Trip: Joined a Group I'm Not Close To
items.overview: An awkward teen joins a group of popular classmates on a school trip, sparking an unexpected romance with the most popular and charming boy in school.

items.listTitle: Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy
items.title: Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy
items.overview: When a teenager goes missing, it becomes clear that many young men and boys have disappeared at the hands of John Wayne Gacy, the prime suspect.

items.title: Mr. Scorsese
items.overview: Explore the many lives of Martin Scorsese through intimate interviews with the man himself, access to his private archives, plus conversations with Robert De Niro, Leonardo DiCaprio, Margot Robbie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Steven Spielberg, and more.

items.title: No One Saw Us Leave
items.overview: A mother faces stigma and a painful separation when her husband takes their children abroad, forever changing her life.

items.title: Murdaugh: Death in the Family
items.overview: Maggie and Alex enjoy a lavish life of privilege as members of one of South Carolina's most powerful legal dynasties. But when their son Paul is involved in a deadly boat crash, the family is faced with a test unlike any they've ever encountered. As details come to light and new challenges emerge, the family's connections to several mysterious deaths raise questions which threaten everything Maggie and Alex hold dear.

items.title: PUNKS△TRIANGLE
items.overview: A young designer dreams of creating a look for his favorite model and finally gets his chance–unless his class partner screws things up!

items.title: Victoria Beckham
items.overview: Step into Victoria Beckham's London atelier, as the Spice Girl-turned-powerhouse designer opens up about her life while preparing for Paris Fashion Week.

items.title: Néro the Assassin
items.overview: France, 1504. A ruthless assassin goes on the run with his estranged daughter in his quest to protect her from deadly enemies and evil forces.

items.title: Film Club
items.overview: Friday night. 7pm. Film Club Week 198. Evie hasn't left the house in six months after a 'wobble', and Film Club is her escape. A weekly chance to create a world of wonder, deck the garage out in whatever the movie calls for and spend a few uninterrupted hours with Noa - her best friend and one of the few mates who still shows up. But tonight, things are different. Noa's got big news. A dream job is taking him across the other side of the country, which means that all of this is ending.

items.title: Dangerous Queen
items.overview:
Bonita spends her time supporting her mother who suffers from alcohol and gambling addiction. In addition to this, her neighbour "Kem" pursues her relentlessly even though she only sees him as a friend.

Her life takes a surprising turn when she goes to a bar and meets "Queen", a high-society woman from a prominent family. Queen helps Bonita escape her mother's abuse and they face various challenges before they become each other's favourite.

"In my life, I have only one favourite person."

items.title: Red Alert
items.overview: From the ambush at an open-air music festival to a family's last stand inside their home, ordinary people face life-or-death situations as a terrorist invasion turns southern Israel into a war zone.

items.title: Player
items.overview: "Pun" A young woman who ventured to America hoping to settle there, hired a man for a marriage contract but was betrayed when he fled with her 1 million baht payment. Now pursued by mysterious mafia groups, she's forced to return to Thailand and hunt down her betrayer for answers. Pun has to extract intel from "Ploy" The gorgeous villain actress of Thai entertainment, who happens to be the betrayer's sister. Hoping proximity will make "Ploy" reveal her brother's secrets, a mission of seduction and heartbreak begins. But the more "Pun" deceives to make her fall in love, the deeper she falls herself. The more traps she sets, the more she gets caught.

items.title: Love Design
items.overview: Two former lovers turned rival architects clash professionally after a betrayal involving stolen work. Their competitive relationship grows more complex when a new romantic interest emerges.

items.listTitle: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin
items.title: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin
items.overview: When a naïve aspiring actor meets a goblin master feared for centuries, their fated bond reignites a love powerful enough to break a thousand-year curse.

items.title: Nightmares of Nature
items.overview: Chilling tales of survival unfurl in this documentary series that captures the drama, danger and dark beauty of nature from the perspective of its prey.

items.title: Ms. Incognito
items.overview: A bodyguard hides in a village as a kindergarten teacher to avoid her boss' enemies – but faces a new challenge in a skeptical strawberry farmer!

items.listTitle: Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?
items.title: Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?
items.overview: Ellen Greenberg was found dead with 20 stab wounds. Philadelphia ruled it suicide. This three-part series follows her family's quest to find the truth.

items.title: The Journey to Killing You
items.overview: Ordered to guard—and secretly kill—his underboss, a vengeful yakuza begins to fall for the very man he swore to destroy.

items.title: Wayward
items.overview: A small-town cop suspects that the local school for troubled teens — and its dangerously charismatic founder — may not be all it seems.

items.listTitle: Jesse & Joy: What We Never Said Before
items.title: Jesse & Joy: What We Never Said Before
items.overview: Jesse & Joy reveal the most intimate side of their story and the conflicts that shaped their identity and their music.

items.title: Marvel Zombies
items.overview: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

items.title: The Hack
items.overview: Set between 2002 and 2012, the drama deftly interweaves two real life stories, the uncovering of phone hacking at the News of the World, and running parallel, the investigation into the unsolved murder of private investigator Daniel Morgan.

items.title: PRI: Crónica del Fin
items.overview: In the past, there was only one path to success in Mexican politics: the path of the PRI. But the PRI is not just a political party; it is the institution that shaped Mexico's public and political behavior. It survived armed uprisings, student movements, economic crises, electoral defeats, and corruption scandals, but it was arrogance, corruption, inconsistency, and abuse of power that ultimately brought it down.

items.title: Poisonous Love
items.overview: Dr. Prem, a flawless heart surgeon, faces chaos when her wedding is ruined by actress Pat. What begins as resentment soon turns into unexpected attraction after a fateful kiss reveals deeper feelings between them.

items.title: That Summer
items.overview: Sent to a remote island for discipline, a troublemaker meets an amnesiac castaway whose presence turns his dull summer into love.

items.title: Black Rabbit
items.overview: A rising-star restaurateur is forced into New York's criminal underworld when his chaotic brother returns to town with loan sharks on his trail.

items.title: My Secret Vampire
items.overview: A naïve student rents a cheap mansion in Seoul, only to learn his generous roommates are vampires—and his blood is the price of admission.

items.title: The Breslau Murders
items.overview: Commissioner Franz Podolsky investigates a brutal murder and, because of the upcoming Olympic Games, the pressure is on to catch the murderer.

items.title: Maledictions
items.overview: At a career-defining moment, a governor's child vanishes. Torn between ambition and family secrets, he must choose: politics or his daughter's safety.

items.title: Beauty and the Bester
items.overview: Did renowned Dr Nandipha get embroiled in Thabo Bester's prison break? This chilling documentary series examines the enigmatic ties that bound them.

items.title: The Dead Girls
items.overview: The story of the Baladro sisters, known as “Las Poquianchis”, who built a brothel empire and became merciless killers in 1960s Mexico.

items.title: The Girlfriend
items.overview: Laura has it all: a glittering career, a loving husband, and her precious son, Daniel. But her perfect life unravels when Daniel brings home Cherry, a girlfriend who changes everything. After a tense introduction, Laura becomes convinced Cherry is hiding something. Is she a manipulative social climber, or is Laura just paranoid? The truth is a matter of perspective.

items.title: aka Charlie Sheen
items.overview: Actor Charlie Sheen tells his story in this candid two-part documentary tracing his dazzling Hollywood rise, tabloid-topping fall and road to recovery.

items.title: Confidence Queen
items.overview: Three con artists with different backgrounds, team up for a daring and adventurous scheme of revenge against the villains of this era.

items.title: Countdown: Canelo vs. Crawford
items.overview: Go inside Canelo Álvarez and Terence Crawford's training camps and personal lives as they prepare for their once in a lifetime super middleweight matchup.

items.title: Quiet Please!
items.overview: One month into living on his own, Yi-hyuk was hoping for an exciting, dramatic start to his independent life—but not this kind of drama. What he doesn’t expect is to be tormented by the thunderous noise coming from the apartment next door. Determined to put an end to it, he confronts his neighbor—only to make things infinitely worse when he accidentally punches him in the face.Yi-hyuk tries everything—from childish pranks to petty power plays—but his neighbor just won’t budge. He even pleads on his knees to make the noise stop. Just when it seems the feud will never end, they finally manage to call an uneasy truce.And somewhere along the way, Yi-hyuk realizes he might be falling for the very person who once drove him up the wall.

items.title: Two Graves
items.overview: When the disappearance of two teen girls shocks a quiet coastal town, a bereft grandmother risks everything to uncover the truth and seek revenge.

items.title: My Bias is Showing?!
items.overview: A flustered teacher scrambles to hide his fanboy side when his idol films at school—but being cast as his co-mentor makes secrets hard to keep.

items.listTitle: Katrina: Come Hell and High Water
items.title: Katrina: Come Hell and High Water
items.overview: Twenty years after Hurricane Katrina, survivors reflect on the disastrous storm that forever changed their lives and the systemic inequities it exposed.

items.title: Twelve
items.overview: A group of heroes, each embodying one of the 12 zodiac signs, battles to defend the Korean Peninsula from malevolent spirits.

items.title: Aema
items.overview: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

items.title: Hostage
items.overview: When the British prime minister's husband is kidnapped and the French president starts receiving threats, both leaders must face an impossible choice.

items.listTitle: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
items.title: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
items.overview: Amanda Knox arrives in Italy for her study abroad only to be wrongfully imprisoned for murder weeks later. Follow Knox's relentless fight to prove her innocence and reclaim her freedom and examines why authorities and the world stood so firmly in judgment.

items.title: Rivers of Fate
items.overview: When a teen is kidnapped by a sex trafficking ring, a river pirate and a fierce mother embark on separate quests to find her — until their paths cross.

items.title: Stalking Samantha: 13 Years of Terror
items.overview: Chained in a soundproof box by the man who stalked her for over a decade, Samantha must rely on her mind to survive. As she escapes, she faces a brutal choice: put Christopher behind bars on lesser charges or risk everything in pursuit of justice.

items.listTitle: Abandoned: The Woman in the Decaying House
items.title: Abandoned: The Woman in the Decaying House
items.overview: After almost 30 years of silence, a victim shares new and disturbing details of the horror she experienced in the home of the person who became known throughout Brazil as the woman with white ointment on her face.

items.listTitle: Fit for TV: The Reality of the Biggest Loser
items.title: Fit for TV: The Reality of the Biggest Loser
items.overview: Takes an inside look at the making of the hit reality TV competition, exploring the good, the bad, and the complicated. Featuring interviews with former contestants, trainers, producers, and health professionals, the documentary examines the show's approach to transformation, the support systems in place, and the unique challenges of filming reality television.

items.listTitle: This Is Not a Murder Mystery
items.title: This Is Not a Murder Mystery
items.overview: Set in the flamboyant 1930s, “This is not a murder mystery” reunites world renowned Surrealist artists, including young Salvador Dalí and René Magritte, who find themselves trapped in a lavish mansion with a mysterious serial killer on the loose.

items.title: In the Mud
items.overview: Five female prisoners forge a unique bond after a deadly accident... until corruption and turf wars within a ruthless prison threaten to destroy them.

items.title: Queendom
items.overview: Enemies since school up to entering the entertainment industry, Rey and Print meet again when they land roles in a highly anticipated series. One week before filming's to begin, however, something strange happens: their souls switch bodies. Chaos ensues. Most importantly, though, their feelings towards one another begin to shift as they embody one another.

items.title: Perfect Days
items.overview: Téo, a solitary medical student burdened by the care of his paraplegic mother, becomes infatuated with Clarice, an aspiring screenwriter he meets at a barbecue. When she rejects his advances, he resorts to an extreme measure: drugging and kidnapping her. He forces Clarice—sedated and trapped as his passenger—on a road trip through the very locations she scripted in her screenplay, attempting to awaken her love through repetition and manipulation.
